criteria.name: LAW001
criteria.description:

Inspect output/safeguards_gap_register.xlsx, output/legal_action_memo.docx, output/ftc_notice_draft.txt.
criteria.reasoning: LAW001 criterion is satisfied. The candidate explicitly states in the memo: '以2025-01-01冻结XML为适用版，当前网页仅检索。2021旧XML用于比较' (using 2025-01-01 frozen XML as applicable version, current webpage only for retrieval, 2021 old XML for comparison only). The Sources sheet in safeguards_gap_register.xlsx documents: (1) ftc_safeguards_guide.html with actual eCFR reference 'https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-16/chapter-I/subchapter-C/part-314', (2) eCFR_16_CFR_314_2025-01-01.xml as '冻结适用版' with specific citations 314.2(m), 314.4(a)-(j), 314.5, 314.6, (3) eCFR_16_CFR_314_2021-12-01.xml marked as '旧版对照' with explicit note '不能用于本事件豁免判断' (cannot be used for this event's exemption judgment). The memo and xlsx both cite specific sections that exist in the 2025 XML (314.4(j) notification system, 314.5 effective date, 314.6 small institution exceptions) but not in the 2021 version. The evidence chain is clearly documented: FTC guide → actual eCFR citations → 2025 frozen XML as authoritative source.

criteria.name: LAW002

The effective date 2024-05-13 for 314.4(j) is stated correctly. The safeguards_gap_register.xlsx Timeline sheet also confirms '2024-05-13, 314.4(j)生效' and Sources sheet references FR_2021-25736 and FR_2023-24412. The FTC notice draft references 314.4(j) for the filing obligation. All three files collectively satisfy the criterion.

criteria.description:

For 5000/550: no small-entity exemption applies, FTC notification required, all four previously-exempt obligations ((b)(1),(d)(2),(h),(i)) now apply. For 4800/499: small-entity exemption applies, but the memo explicitly states '安全计划和其余义务不因此消失' (security plan and other obligations don't disappear) and '人数需持续核实' (numbers need continuous verification), correctly distinguishing that not reaching the 500-person FTC notification threshold does not exempt the institution from its security obligations. This directly satisfies the criterion's requirement not to conflate 499-person notification exemption with exemption from security obligations.
